newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign ministers of six Gulf Arab states, Egypt and Syria to meet on Wednesday in Damascus to discuss an Egyptian proposal to sign a security agreement.
- British minister says Middle East peace process could not be resumed if Israel maintained its current policy.
- Saudi businessman Prince Al-Waleed allocates $500 million to information and tourism investments in Lebanon.
- OPEC plans a six-month extension of its current production ceiling.
- Bankers urge Arab banks to merge and provide specialised banking services.
- Saudi Yanbu refinery to start opertions in the third quarter of 1997. The refinery has a two million barrel per day capacity.
- Jordan signs three agreements in Abu Dhabi worth $25 million with the Arab Monetary Fund.
